title: FAME: Framework for Allocation with Modular Evaluation
description: Version 1.1.0 of the FAME reproducibility archive. This release organizes the project into two companion research tracks: (1) FAME/DOC temporal transferability of learned prediction-to-decision representations, and (2) DRR/DRVM post-deployment validity monitoring of frozen prediction-to-decision representations. The release adds controlled DRVM Monte Carlo validation, real historical deployment replays in fantasy football and Energy, temporal reference-risk stress tests, baseline-uplift sensitivity outputs, and an explicit manuscript/reproducibility map. Existing third-party-data redistribution boundaries remain unchanged.
